content: IBD MarketSmith (now MarketSurge) is the gold standard for swing traders using industry group data. Key display elements: RS Rating 1-99 (stock vs all others, trailing 52 weeks); RS Line chart overlay (stock relative to S&P 500); 197 industry group ranks from best (1) to worst (197), calculated via least-squares curve fit on summed group member prices; rank change vs 3 months and 6 months prior shows trend direction. IBD best-practice: buy only stocks in industry groups ranked in top 40 of 197 (top 20%). Group rank displayed as two numbers — current rank and prior rank (e.g., '15 → 8' means moved from 15 to 8, improving). Minimum actionable display: industry group name, current rank out of 197, delta vs 4 weeks ago (+/-), top-20% flag. For non-IBD tools: percent above/below 50-day MA for the sector ETF and relative performance vs SPY over 20 days are the two most commonly shown fields.
